text:
maya: Quick heads-up — AcmeCorp private VPC deploy scheduled TOMORROW 02:00 UTC (window 02:00–03:00). This is the runtime + config rollout (model v2.3.1, quantized). Need a volunteer to own hands-on deploy, someone watching smoke, and rollback readiness. @oliver @dan any chance you can be on call?
oliver: I can take primary for the deploy, happy to be there. planning 45m total, will run canary -> 25% -> 100%.
dan: I can be backup and run the smoke checklist. Will be online and reachable on my cell.
samir: Adding a few notes — please follow the private-runbook steps under Confluence and ensure the KV cache warmup is enabled for the canary group. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/private-deploys/acme-runbook
maya: thx. deploy-bot will create the slot and lock traffic. Can we drop a minimal smoke checklist here so dan/oliver have it?
dan: Smoke checklist (short):
- Verify k8s rollout: `kubectl -n acme rollout status deploy/rw-serving --timeout=6m`
- Health endpoint: `curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" https://acme-vpc.internal/healthz` (expect 200 + JSON {"status":"ok"})
- Quick inference sanity: `curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://acme-vpc.internal/v1/generate | jq .choices[0].text` should return non-empty string
- KV cache check: run `redis-cli -h kv.acme.internal --rdb` and confirm prefix keys populated (or check metrics `rw_cache_kv_hits` > 0)
- Latency spot-check: sample 10 requests, p50 < 300ms p95 < 800ms for 512-token workload
jen: I'll be on watch for logs and metrics in the console. I can do the tracing hook for the canary to validate routing.
oliver: Plan for rollback: previous image sha `sha256:7b3a1f...` pinned in the rollback manifest. If p95 > 1200ms or error rate > 1% in first 10 min of canary, we abort and roll back.
maya: good thresholds. Also keep an eye on GPU memory OOMs — set alert if GPU OOM rate > 0.5% during rollout.
dan: I’ll prepare the smoke token and a small script to run the checks, will post it 30m before window.
deploy-bot: :calendar: Deployment slot reserved for acme-corp-vpc by oliver at 2025-07-29T02:00:00Z. Lock acquired.
oliver: Quick ask — can someone confirm that KMS key rotation is disabled for the window? We need consistent keys for model artifacts. @maya
maya: Confirmed, KMS rotation disabled for that resource during window.
samir: Also check bursting policy — disable autoscale burst > 2x for the first 10m so we don't mask regressions.
jen: I'll keep dashboards open (routes: /dash/acme/latency, /dash/acme/errors) and will post screenshots at 5/15/30 min marks.
dan: Script ready (will paste 30m prior). Suggest we use this rollback command if needed: `kubectl -n acme set image deploy/rw-serving rw-serving=myregistry/rw-serving@sha256:7b3a1f... && kubectl -n acme rollout status deploy/rw-serving`
oliver: Sounds good. Final note — after 100% rollout, we should run a full 30-min canary-parity pass (randomized traffic) before we close the window. If all green, I'll mark the deploy done and remove locks.
maya: thanks team. tagging this thread as the authoritative deploy coordination for the window. If anything unexpected comes up, call me on Slack/phone. :thumbsup:
